Method of Attack: Embedding open-source Android XploitSPY Remote Access Trojan (RAT) into apps
Extracting sensitive data such as contact lists, call logs, installed apps, GPS location, and files
Sending SMS messages, taking pictures, recording audio, intercepting notifications, and extracting specific filenames via commands
Attack Vector: Disguising as legitimate apps such as messaging apps and utility apps
Distributed through dedicated websites and the Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: Fake C2 server to evade detection
Native library 'defcome-lib.so' to hide C2 server information
